name: Commodity Index (DJP)
source: Total Real Returns, DJP total return chart (nominal annualized total return, as of 2026-11-11)
methodology: Market-price total return from an aggregator; the issuer's own figure could not be read.

name: Individual Stock Picking (Retail)
source: Barber & Odean, The Common Stock Investment Performance of Individual Investors (66,465 discount-broker households, 1991-1996); Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills (S&P 500 with dividends)
methodology: The S&P 500's 10.02% less the 1.8-point yearly gap Barber & Odean measured between the average household (15.3%) and the market (17.1%), net of costs. The most active fifth trailed by 7.1 points.

name: Penny Stocks (Retail Avg)
source: Ang, Shtauber & Tetlock, Asset Pricing in the Dark: The Cross-Section of OTC Stocks (NBER WP 19309, 2013); Damodaran T-bill returns
methodology: The OTC market returned -0.8% a month below T-bills (value-weighted): -9.6% a year plus the period's 5.95% T-bill average. Equal weighting, closer to a small retail holding, would be worse.

name: S&P 500 After 0.03% Index Fee
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 0.03% index-fund expense ratio.

name: S&P 500 After 0.35% Robo-Advisor
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 0.35% robo-advisor fee.

name: S&P 500 After 0.60% Target-Date Fund
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 0.60% target-date fund expense ratio.

name: S&P 500 After 1% Advisory Fee
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 1% assets-under-management advisory fee.

name: S&P 500 After 1.5% Active Mutual Fund
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 1.5% active-fund expense ratio, assuming the fund matches the index before fees.

name: S&P 500 After 2-and-20 Hedge Fund
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) less a 2% management fee, then 20% of the remaining 8% as performance fee.

name: S&P 500 After 2-and-20 (Underperforming)
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills (S&P 500 with dividends)
methodology: A 2% management fee and 20% of what remains: (10.02 - 2) x 0.8. Applied year by year with a high-water mark it is 6.46%. The HFRI Fund Weighted Composite returned 9.15% a year 1990-2025, 5.35% over 2006-2025.

name: S&P 500 After LTCG Tax (20%)
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) with 20% of each year's return taxed away. A simplification: real long-term gains are taxed only on sale, so a buy-and-hold investor does better.

name: S&P 500 After STCG Tax (37%)
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row (10.0%) with 37% of each year's return taxed as short-term gains, as for a position turned over inside a year.

name: S&P 500 After 1% Fee + LTCG Tax
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, S&P 500 including dividends
methodology: The S&P 500 row less a 1% advisory fee (9.0%), then 20% of that taxed.

name: Qualified Dividends (SPYD) After 15% Tax
source: State Street (SPDR), SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 High Dividend ETF, fund performance and distribution yield (as of 2026-09-30 and 2026-11-11)
methodology: The SPYD row (8.81%) less 15% of its 4.12% distribution yield: 8.81 - 0.62 = 8.19%. About a quarter of the fund is REITs, whose dividends are mostly not qualified, so this flatters it.

name: Money Market Fund (SPAXX/VMFXX)
source: Crane Data, Crane 100 Money Fund Index (annualized 7-day current yield, 3.71% as of 2026-10-19)
methodology: The average yield of the 100 largest taxable money market funds, which the big brokerage sweep funds track closely. Moves with the Fed funds rate.

name: High-Yield Savings Account (Online)
source: Bankrate, Best high-yield savings accounts (editorial picks dated 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20)
methodology: A top online savings rate: Bankrate's picks ranged 3.75% to 4.27%, with several banks at 4.20%. Promotional and balance-capped rates excluded. Variable; moves with the Fed funds rate.

name: 1-Year CD (Top Rate)
source: Bankrate, Best 1-year CD rates of November 2026 (top APY, rates updated 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-11)
methodology: The highest APY among Bankrate's picks.

name: 6-Month CD
source: Bankrate, Best 6-month CD rates for November 2026 (top APY, rates updated 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-11)
methodology: The highest APY among Bankrate's picks; the FDIC national average is 1.39%.

name: High-Yield Money Market Account
source: Bankrate, Best money market accounts of November 2026 (top editorial-pick APY as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The highest APY among Bankrate's editorial picks, sponsored listings left out.

name: Cash Management Account (SoFi/Wealthfront)
source: Wealthfront, Cash Account (base APY as of 2026-10-01)
methodology: Base rate without promotional boosts; SoFi's savings rate with direct deposit is 3.30% (2026-10-20).

name: No-Penalty CD
source: NerdWallet, Best No-Penalty CD Rates of November 2026 (top APY, updated 2026-11-12)
methodology: The highest APY in the table; Marcus, the best large national bank listed, pays 4.00%.

name: 3-Month CD
source: Fortune, Top CD rates Nov. 11, 2026 (Curinos table, top 3-month APY, as of 2026-11-11)
methodology: The highest 3-month APY in the table; the FDIC national average is 1.14%.

name: 2-Year CD
source: Bankrate, Best 2-year CD rates for November 2026 (top APY, rates updated 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-11)
methodology: The highest APY among Bankrate's picks; the FDIC national average is 1.55%.

name: 5-Year CD
source: Bankrate, Best 5-year CD rates for November 2026 (top APY, rates updated 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-11)
methodology: The highest APY among Bankrate's picks; the FDIC national average is 1.41%.

name: Bank Money Market (Traditional)
source: FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps (national deposit rates published 2026-10-19)
methodology: FDIC national average money market deposit rate.

name: Credit Union Savings
source: NCUA, Comparison of Average Savings, Deposits and Loan Rates at Credit Unions and Banks (Q4 2025)
methodology: National average credit union rate on a regular savings account with a $2,500 balance; NCUA's latest quarterly table.

name: National Average Savings Rate
source: FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps (national deposit rates published 2026-10-19)
methodology: FDIC national average savings deposit rate.

name: Big Bank Savings (Chase/BofA)
source: Bankrate big-bank comparison (Chase Savings 0.01%, Bank of America Savings 0.04%, as of 2026-10-20)
methodology: Standard savings rate at the largest US banks; relationship tiers can add a few basis points.

name: Regular Checking Account
source: FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps (national interest checking rate published 2026-10-19)
methodology: FDIC national average rate on interest-bearing checking.

name: HYSA After Income Tax (24%)
source: Bankrate, Best high-yield savings accounts (editorial picks dated 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20)
methodology: The high-yield savings row (4.2%) with interest taxed as ordinary income at 24%.

source: Bankrate, Best high-yield savings accounts (editorial picks dated 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20)
methodology: The high-yield savings row (4.2%) with interest taxed as ordinary income at 37%.

source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares iBoxx $ Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-06-30)
methodology: NAV total return since inception, annualized, distributions reinvested.

source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares National Muni Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)

source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)

source: Vanguard, Total International Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)

source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)

source: Vanguard, Total Bond Market ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: The Total US Bond Market row (2.86%) less a 1% advisory fee.

source: Vanguard, Total Bond Market ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: The Total US Bond Market row (2.86%) taxed as ordinary income at 37%: 2.86 x 0.63.

source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares National Muni Bond ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: The Municipal Bond Index row unchanged: muni interest is exempt from federal income tax.

name: Treasury Interest After Federal Tax (24%)
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, US T. Bond (10-year)
methodology: The US Treasury 10-Year row (4.54%) taxed at a 24% federal rate: 4.54 x 0.76. Treasury interest is exempt from state tax.

name: Multi-Unit Apartments (5+ Units)
source: Nareit, Annual Returns by Property Sector and Subsector (FTSE Nareit Apartments total return)
methodology: Compound annual total return chained from Nareit's yearly Apartments figures: 20.069^(1/32) - 1. Listed, levered REITs stand in for direct ownership.

name: Industrial / Warehouse
source: Nareit, Annual Returns by Property Sector and Subsector (FTSE Nareit Industrial total return)
methodology: Compound annual total return chained from Nareit's yearly Industrial figures: 21.877^(1/32) - 1. Listed, levered REITs stand in for direct ownership.

name: Multi Single Family Portfolio
source: Nareit, REITWatch October 2026 (Single Family Homes subsector total returns)
methodology: Compound annual total return of the single-family-rental REIT subsector across ten calendar years. Listed and levered; through October 2026 it is 7.6%.

name: Single Family Home (Buy & Hold)
source: Jorda, Knoll, Kuvshinov, Schularick & Taylor, The Rate of Return on Everything, 1870-2015 (FRBSF Working Paper 2017-25, Table 7, US housing nominal total return)
methodology: Arithmetic mean 8.87% (3.54% price gain plus 5.33% rent net of costs) less half the variance (8.40^2/200) to approximate a compound rate.

name: Commercial Office Space
source: Nareit, Annual Returns by Property Sector and Subsector (FTSE Nareit Office total return)
methodology: Compound annual total return chained from Nareit's yearly Office figures: 9.072^(1/32) - 1. Listed, levered REITs stand in for direct ownership.

name: Retail / Strip Mall
source: Nareit, Annual Returns by Property Sector and Subsector (FTSE Nareit Shopping Centers total return)
methodology: Compound annual total return chained from Nareit's yearly Shopping Centers figures: 11.003^(1/32) - 1. Listed, levered REITs stand in for direct ownership. The whole Retail sector, malls included, is 8.81%.

name: Raw Land (Speculative)
source: USDA NASS, Land Values 2025 Summary (US farm real estate value per acre, August 2025); 2015 value via UNL CropWatch
methodology: $3,020 to $4,350 an acre: (4350 / 3020)^(1/10) - 1. Price only, before property tax and carrying costs; productive farmland, not speculative lots.

name: House Flipping (Retail Avg)
source: ATTOM, 2025 Year-End Home Flipping Report (gross flipping profit, March 2026)
methodology: Gross profit $65,981 on a $259,019 purchase (25.5%) before rehab and other costs, which ATTOM puts at 20-33% of the resale value. At 25% the flip loses 4.5% over 163 days: (0.955)^(365/163) - 1.

name: Timeshare
source: ARDA International Foundation, Shared Vacation Ownership Resale Study 2013 (median resale price) and 2010 Owners Report (median purchase price)
methodology: A $11,500 purchase resold for $4,000: (4000 / 11500)^(1/10) - 1. Maintenance fees, not counted, make it worse.

name: Rental Income After Ordinary Tax (37%)
source: Jorda, Knoll, Kuvshinov, Schularick & Taylor, The Rate of Return on Everything, 1870-2015 (NBER WP 24112, US housing rental income)
methodology: The 5.33% US net rental yield (after maintenance and depreciation) taxed as ordinary income at 37%: 5.33 x 0.63.

name: Home Sale After LTCG (w/ $250K Exclusion)
source: FRED, S&P Cotality Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index (CSUSHPINSA, latest August 2026)
methodology: Price only, as an owner-occupier earns no rent: (336.741 / 63.732)^(1/39.58) - 1. The $250K exclusion covers a typical gain, so no tax is taken.

name: Bitcoin Spot (Buy & Hold)
source: FRED, Coinbase Bitcoin (CBBTCUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: Price change only, no fees or custody: (70,822.24 / 704.53)^(1/10) - 1. From the series start (2014-12) it is 55.24%.

name: Ethereum Spot (Buy & Hold)
source: FRED, Coinbase Ethereum (CBETHUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: Price change only: (2,006.46 / 9.95)^(1/10) - 1. Very sensitive to the start date: from 2016-05-18 it is 61.49%.

name: Stablecoin Yield Farming
source: DefiLlama, Yields API (single-stablecoin pools with at least $10M TVL, as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: TVL-weighted median APY of 268 pools holding $30.4B; 3.85% without reward tokens. Aave v3 pays 5.77% on USDC and 3.31% on USDT.

name: Staked Ethereum (ETH + Staking Yield)
source: FRED, Coinbase Ethereum (CBETHUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12); Lido, stETH APR (7-day average, as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The Ethereum row (70.02%) plus Lido's 2.33% staking APR, net of Lido's fee. Staking began in December 2020, so this flatters the early years; slashing and liquidity risk are ignored.

name: Leveraged Perpetual Futures (Retail Avg)
methodology: Representative annual outcome for retail accounts trading 10x-plus perpetual swaps: funding costs plus liquidation losses. Approximate.

name: Bitcoin Spot ETF After 0.25% Fee (IBIT)
source: FRED, Coinbase Bitcoin (CBBTCUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12); iShares (BlackRock), iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (sponsor fee, as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The Bitcoin Spot row (58.58%) less the 0.25% sponsor fee.

name: Bitcoin After LTCG Tax (20%)
source: FRED, Coinbase Bitcoin (CBBTCUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The Bitcoin Spot row (58.58%) less 20% long-term capital gains tax: 58.58 x 0.8.

name: Bitcoin After STCG Tax (37%)
source: FRED, Coinbase Bitcoin (CBBTCUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The Bitcoin Spot row (58.58%) taxed as ordinary income at 37%: 58.58 x 0.63.

name: Ethereum After LTCG Tax (20%)
source: FRED, Coinbase Ethereum (CBETHUSD), daily close (as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: The Ethereum Spot row (70.02%) less 20% long-term capital gains tax: 70.02 x 0.8.

name: Fine Art (Blue Chip / Old Masters)
source: CKGSB and Bocconi, MM Art Indices 2025 Annual Report (Europe Art Price Index, released 2026-01-14)
methodology: Auction price index of 5,578 European artists (Sotheby's, Christie's, Phillips) from 1 to 1.61: 1.9% a year. No fees, premiums or insurance; the Americas index is 4.1%.

name: Fine Wine (Investment Grade)
source: Knight Frank, The Wealth Report 2026, Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index (10-year change, data to Q4 2025), Liv-ex Fine Wine 100
methodology: Price index up 34.1% in 10 years: 1.341^(1/10) - 1. No storage or dealer costs. Very window-sensitive: to Q4 2023 it was 9.4% a year.

name: Classic Cars (Pre-1970)
source: Knight Frank, The Wealth Report 2026, Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index (10-year change, data to Q4 2025), HAGI collector-car index
methodology: Price index up 31.3% in 10 years: 1.313^(1/10) - 1. HAGI is not limited to pre-1970 cars; no storage, insurance or auction costs.

name: Luxury Watches (Rolex/Patek)
source: Knight Frank, The Wealth Report 2024, Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index (watches, 10-year change, data to Q4 2023)
methodology: Price index up 138% in 10 years: 2.38^(1/10) - 1. Stops before the 2024-25 fall; Knight Frank's 2026 index has no 10-year watch figure.

name: NFT Art & Digital Collectibles
source: Cointelegraph, NFTs' utility, culture and price faded in 2025 (CoinGecko total NFT market cap, 2025-12-24)
methodology: Market cap from about $16.8B at the peak to $2.56B: (2.56 / 16.8)^(1/3.69) - 1. Starts at the peak; market cap is not a holder's return.

name: Collectibles After 28% Tax Rate
source: Knight Frank, The Wealth Report 2026, Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index (10-year change, data to Q4 2025), overall index
methodology: The overall luxury index, up 38.6% in 10 years (3.32% a year), less the 28% collectibles capital gains rate: 3.32 x 0.72.

name: Gold Bullion (Physical / GLD)
source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills, gold column
methodology: Compound annual growth of the gold price over the last 50 years: 7.11%. The series runs from 1928, but gold's price was fixed until 1971, so the full span understates a free market. Physical or GLD holding costs come off this.

name: Rhodium (Physical)
source: Johnson Matthey, PGM prices (rhodium base price, as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: Price change only, no storage or dealer costs: (9,300 / 2,175)^(1/34.1) - 1. Very sensitive to the window: 2000-2025 gives 6.16%.

name: Gold Mining Stocks (GDX)
source: VanEck, Gold Miners ETF fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-10-31)
methodology: NAV total return since inception, annualized, distributions reinvested.

name: Silver Bullion (Physical / SLV)
source: iShares (BlackRock), iShares Silver Trust fact sheet (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: NAV return of a physically backed trust, after its fee. Silver fell sharply in October and November 2026, so the next fact sheet will be lower.

name: Copper Futures (CPER)
source: USCF, United States Copper Index Fund, performance (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: NAV total return since inception, annualized, distributions reinvested.

name: Palladium Bullion (PALL)
source: abrdn, Physical Palladium Shares ETF performance data (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: NAV return of a physically backed fund, after its fee.

name: Silver Mining Stocks (SIL)
source: Global X, Silver Miners ETF (NAV since inception, as of 2026-10-31)
methodology: NAV total return since inception, annualized, distributions reinvested.

name: Platinum Bullion (PPLT)
source: abrdn, Physical Platinum Shares ETF performance data (NAV since inception, as of 2026-09-30)
methodology: NAV return of a physically backed fund, after its fee; the 10-year figure is 4.55%.

name: Precious Coins (Numismatic)
source: PCGS, PCGS3000 Rare Coin Index (value as of 2026-11-11)
methodology: Index from $46,818.77 to $73,111.56 over 31.95 years. Price only: dealer spreads, grading and storage are extra, and the figure swings with the start date.

name: Junior Mining Stocks (GDXJ)

source: ImmediateAnnuities.com, life-only quote (male 65, $100,000, $690 a month, 2026-11-12); SSA Period Life Table 2023 (life expectancy 18.12 years)

source: The Finance Buff, Whole Life Case Study (IRR of a MassMutual Whole Life Legacy 10 Pay illustration, 2016-11-30)

source: Barber, Lee, Liu & Odean, 'Do Day Traders Rationally Learn About Their Ability?' (2014); Chague, De-Losso & Giovannetti, 'Day Trading for a Living?' (2020)

name: Sharp Bettor (+2% Closing Line Value)
source: Football-Data.co.uk (Buchdahl), The Efficiency of the Pinnacle.com Closing Line (87,960 odds pairs, 2016-08-04)

source: BettingUSA, Reduced juice (bettingusa.com/sports/bonuses/reduced-juice/)

name: Single Game Spread (-110)
source: Wizard of Odds, Sports betting (wizardofodds.com/games/sports-betting/)

name: Single Game O/U (-110)
source: Wizard of Odds, Sports betting (wizardofodds.com/games/sports-betting/)

source: Wizard of Odds, Sports betting (wizardofodds.com/games/sports-betting/)

name: Teaser 2-Team 6pt
source: Wizard of Odds, NFL Teasers (2-team 6-point teaser analysis, 4,450 games 1994-2012, page updated 2026-08-03)
methodology: A random leg covers 68.3%, so both cover 46.9%: 0.469264 x 1.8333 - 1 at -120. A Wong teaser (legs through 3 and 7) is about -1.7%.

name: Live / In-Game Bet

methodology: Taker fee 0.05 x (1 - 0.50) = 2.5% of stake on culture markets plus the measured half-spread of 2.51% across 74 traded markets.

name: PredictIt US Politics
source: PredictIt, How to Trade on PredictIt - Our Fees (10% fee on profit, no standard withdrawal fee, as of 2026-11-12)
methodology: At a 50c price half of contracts win $0.50 and pay 10% of it: 0.5 x 0.05 / 0.50 = 5%. The old 5% withdrawal fee is gone.

name: Pull-Tab Tickets
source: Minnesota Gambling Control Board, FY2025 Annual Report (receipts by game type)
methodology: Net receipts over gross receipts, paper and electronic: 654,335,984 / 4,688,656,626. Minnesota's charitable pull-tabs pay unusually well.

name: $1 Scratch-Off Best Odds
source: Michigan Bureau of State Lottery, 2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (instant payout by price point)
methodology: Michigan's $1 instant games pay 60%; New Hampshire's pay 62%. Cheap tickets pay the least, whatever their odds of any win.

name: Bingo Hall Session
source: Minnesota Gambling Control Board, FY2025 Annual Report (paper bingo gross and net receipts)
methodology: Net receipts over gross receipts: 22,168,955 / 92,817,969 kept, the rest paid as prizes.

name: Premium Scratch-Off $20+
source: Michigan Bureau of State Lottery, 2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (instant payout by price point)
methodology: Michigan's $50 instant games pay 80%. $20 games pay about 74% (New Hampshire FY2025).

name: Scratch-Off Tickets Avg
source: Michigan Bureau of State Lottery, 2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (instant prizes and sales)
methodology: Instant prizes over instant sales: 1,722.9 / 2,265.0 ($M). iLottery excluded; New Hampshire's average is 72.85% paid.

name: Keno State-Run
source: New Hampshire Lottery Commission, FY2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (prizes to sales)
methodology: Keno prizes over keno revenue: 41,113,087 / 59,443,282 = 69.16% paid.

name: Daily Numbers Game
source: Florida Department of the Lottery, Rule 53ER26-8, Fantasy 5 (prize divisions, effective 2026-01-30)
methodology: 50% of net sales funds the cash prizes; net sales leave out the free tickets won by matching two of five (11.92% of plays): 0.50 / 0.8808 - 1.

name: State Pick 6 / Lotto
source: Florida Department of the Lottery, Rule 53ER26-9, Florida Lotto (base game prize pool, effective 2026-01-30)
methodology: 50% of net sales funds the prizes, free-ticket prizes included.

name: State Lottery Pick 3/4
source: Pennsylvania Lottery, Pick 3 and Pick 4 prizes and odds (palottery.pa.gov/Games/PICK-3/Prizes-Odds.aspx)
methodology: A $1 straight pays $500 at 1 in 1,000 (Pick 3) and $5,000 at 1 in 10,000 (Pick 4): 500/1000 - 1 = -50%.

name: EuroMillions
source: EuroMillions game procedures: 50% of ticket revenue is allocated to the prize fund
methodology: Expected return equals the prize-fund share of sales, ignoring unclaimed prizes.

name: Charity 50/50 Raffle
source: Kansas City Chiefs, official 50/50 raffle rules (chiefs.com/fans/5050rules)
methodology: By construction half the pot goes to the single winner and half to the cause.

name: Powerball / Mega Millions
source: Massachusetts Powerball rules, 961 CMR 2.63(4)(a) (law.cornell.edu/regulations/massachusetts/961-CMR-2-63)
methodology: The prize pool is 50% of each drawing period's sales. Mega Millions rules allow up to 55%, so its edge is no better than -45%.

name: Multi-State Cash4Life
source: Florida Cash4Life rule 53ER20-43, section 6 (law.cornell.edu/regulations/florida/Fla-Admin-Code-Ann-R-53ER20-43)
methodology: The prize fund is 55% of each drawing period's sales. The game ended on 2026-02-21, replaced by Millionaire for Life.
